Scenario fixture: rgaa-moving-content-review (RGAA 13.8)

Each target has a stable id of the form mcr_case_NN. Content that moves by itself for more than 5 seconds can be stopped, hidden or read without the movement.

01 — CANTTELL: a scrolling marquee
Promotion
02 — CANTTELL: a background video that plays by itself, with no controls
03 — NOT APPLICABLE: a video the user starts and can pause
